web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's economic data for July showed a slowdown. Industrial output rose 4.5%, missing the estimated 4.8% growth and slowing from June's 5.3% rise. Retail sales grew by just 0.6%, falling short of the expected 1.5% increase and decelerating from June's 1% growth. Urban fixed-asset investment contracted 6.7% year-on-year, worsening from the 5.7% decline in the first half of the year. Despite these indicators, market participants widely expect China to maintain its loan rates steady in August.
